approvalGates: Verify each brand and select its exact product image with source URL.
Human reviews selected source, garment references and top-only scope.
Confirm current price and authorize the exact paid request while preserving unrelated global pause.
Generate one hardest short pilot per brand independently from the generic base.
Inspect all pilot frames for face, hands, lettering, product construction, occlusion, room and camera drift.
Human watches each complete pilot with audio.
Only then prepare any additional segments, voice/lip-sync personalization or a permitted outbound message.
audioPlan: Apparel-only repair retains existing speech. Speaking Disobedient or VYLIN would need a separately approved voice and matching mouth-animation stage, then final audio QA; it is not an object-swap prompt effect.
